startupErrorTitle.text: Your data could not be opened
startupErrorTitle.desc: Title of the screen shown when the encrypted database cannot be opened at launch

startupErrorLocked.text: The encryption key for this device's data is not available. Nothing has been deleted. Restarting the device often helps. If you recently restored the device, restore your data from an encrypted backup instead.

startupErrorCipher.text: This device does not support the encrypted storage the app requires. Nothing has been saved unencrypted.
startupErrorCipher.desc: Explanation when the database encryption library is missing

startupErrorRetry.desc: Button to retry opening the data
